reserveReview.rationale: UHY's independent auditors' reasonable-assurance report, dated September 16, 2026 and performed under NBC TO 3000/ISAE 3000, covers the assertion that the fair value of BRL reserve assets was at least the BRLA in circulation as of August 31, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM UTC. The report records BRL 55,450,919.48 of cash and equivalents and BRL 107,999,999.90 of overnight repurchase agreements, totaling BRL 163,450,919.38 against BRL 132,765,684.39 of BRLA in circulation; its opinion states the assertion is adequately presented. Cash balances are itemized across Stark Bank, Woovi, BTG Pactual, Itaú Unibanco, and XP Investimentos, while the repos are with XP and collateralized by Brazilian corporate debentures with next-business-day liquidity. The normalized composition is 33.925119% cash and 66.074881% repos; the report does not identify each debenture issuer or establish reserve-account legal safeguards.
